caption:
ओह नो! क्या दीपिका पादुकोण एक्टिंग क्लास में रो पड़ी थीं? 😱

फराह खान की फिल्म Om Shanti Om से पहले दीपिका ने मुंबई के Actor Prepares स्कूल में तीन महीने का कोर्स किया था।
रविवार को IFFI Goa में पैनल डिस्कशन के दौरान अनुपम खेर ने यह मजेदार किस्सा सुनाया।
अनुपम का कहना है कि दीपिका तब एक जानी-मानी मॉडल थीं और बहुत पढ़े-लिखे परिवार से थीं, इसलिए उनका हर अंदाज़ बहुत prim और proper था।
अनुपम ने बताया कि एक एक्टिंग एक्सरसाइज के दौरान जब उन्होंने दीपिका को नौकरानी का रोल करके झाड़ू लगाने को कहा, तो वह संघर्ष करते-करते लगभग रोने लगी थीं और frustrate हो गई थीं।
अनुपम ने अपनी घर की नौकरानी को बुलाकर सही तरीके से झाड़ू लगवाई ताकि दीपिका को समझ आ सके और उन्होंने तब तक यह एक्सरसाइज कराई जब तक भरोसा नहीं हो गया।
आखिरकार दीपिका ने यह कर दिखाया और इसके लिए शुक्रिया भी कहा, क्योंकि क्राफ्ट की प्रैक्टिस करना बहुत ज़रूरी है।
आपको क्या लगता है, एक्टर्स को ऐसी मुश्किल ट्रेनिंग से गुजरना चाहिए या नहीं? 💭

ctx.title: ‘She was frustrated’: Anupam Kher recalls Deepika Padukone’s maid act in acting class
ctx.text:
Before making her acting debut opposite Shah Rukh Khan in Farah Khan’s 2007 film Om Shanti Om, Deepika Padukone did a three-month course at Anupam Kher’s acting school, Actor Prepares in Mumbai. During a panel discussion at IFFI Goa on Sunday, Anupam recalled an acting exercise in which he asked Deepika to play a maid. He also revealed that she was left frustrated and nearly in tears after struggling to perform the role convincingly.
During the session, Anupam Kher emphasised the importance of practising the craft of acting, citing Deepika’s experience at his acting school to illustrate his point.
Anupam said, “Deepika Padukone was our student in the second batch. She was a well-known model. Farah decided to cast her in the film with Shah Rukh Khan. It was a 3-month course. Because Deepika was a model and came from a very educated background, she was very prim and proper. She would do everything properly. She used to pick up the cup of tea with that style. Sometimes, there was no believability.”
The actor then recalled how Deepika Padukone initially struggled to portray a maid convincingly during an acting exercise.

“One day, I was taking the class and told her to play a maid, who has to just sweep the floor. She was doing that also with a charm. Then, I called my home maid and asked her to sweep the floor. She did it with total conviction,” he said.
“I told Deepika that we would be doing this exercise till I believe you are actually doing it. She was frustrated initially, and almost had tears in her eyes. But, she did it and she thanked me. You have to do it. You have to constantly practice, and yet be street smart to get work,” Anupam concluded.
